default_currency.label: Default currency
default_currency.description: Platform default billing currency for invoices and payments.
default_currency.tooltip: Used when recording payments and on workspace billing summaries. Example: USD.

vat_percentage.label: VAT / tax percentage
vat_percentage.description: Default tax rate applied to subscription invoices.
vat_percentage.tooltip: Applied during manual payment recording to compute invoice tax. Example: 15.

tax_inclusive_pricing.label: Tax-inclusive pricing
tax_inclusive_pricing.description: Whether listed plan prices already include tax.
tax_inclusive_pricing.tooltip: Reserved for checkout pricing display. Currently stored for future checkout integration.

grace_period_days.label: Grace period duration
grace_period_days.description: Days after a failed renewal before the subscription expires.
grace_period_days.tooltip: Used when a renewal fails or a trial ends without payment. Subscription enters grace period, then expires after this many days.

auto_renewal_default.label: Auto-renewal default
auto_renewal_default.description: Default auto-renewal flag for newly created subscriptions.
auto_renewal_default.tooltip: New subscriptions inherit this value. When off, successful payments do not schedule the next renewal date.

trial_duration_days.label: Trial duration
trial_duration_days.description: Default trial length in days for new subscriptions.
trial_duration_days.tooltip: Used when creating a subscription with trial. Example: 14-day trial ends 14 days after start.

invoice_number_format.label: Invoice number format
invoice_number_format.description: Token pattern for generated invoice numbers.
invoice_number_format.tooltip: Tokens: {YYYY}, {MM}, {COMPANY_ID_SHORT}, {SEQ}. Applied when recording a payment.

receipt_number_format.label: Receipt number format
receipt_number_format.description: Token pattern for generated receipt numbers.
receipt_number_format.tooltip: Tokens: {YYYY}, {MM}, {COMPANY_ID_SHORT}, {SEQ}. Applied when recording a payment.

default_payment_terms_days.label: Default payment terms
default_payment_terms_days.description: Days until invoice due date from issue date.
default_payment_terms_days.tooltip: Invoice due date = issue date + this value. Visible on invoice history after payment recording.

invoice_logo_url.label: Invoice logo URL
invoice_logo_url.description: Platform issuer logo URL for billing documents.
invoice_logo_url.tooltip: Stored for document branding. PDF generation will consume this in a later phase.

invoice_footer_text.label: Invoice footer text
invoice_footer_text.description: Footer text on platform billing documents.
invoice_footer_text.tooltip: Stored for document branding. PDF generation will consume this in a later phase.

issuer_legal_name.label: Issuer legal name
issuer_legal_name.description: Legal entity name shown on invoices.
issuer_legal_name.tooltip: Stored for document branding. PDF generation will consume this in a later phase.

issuer_address.label: Issuer address
issuer_address.tooltip: Stored for document branding. PDF generation will consume this in a later phase.

issuer_tax_id.label: Issuer tax ID
issuer_tax_id.tooltip: Stored for document branding. PDF generation will consume this in a later phase.

payment_retry_max_attempts.label: Payment retry max attempts
payment_retry_max_attempts.description: Maximum automatic payment retries after failure.
payment_retry_max_attempts.tooltip: Reserved for the payment retry worker. Stored and audited today.

payment_retry_interval_hours.label: Payment retry interval
payment_retry_interval_hours.tooltip: Reserved for the payment retry worker. Stored and audited today.

supported_payment_method_codes.label: Supported payment methods
supported_payment_method_codes.description: Payment method types enabled for checkout and manual recording.
supported_payment_method_codes.tooltip: Only selected methods appear in Record Payment. Disabled methods are hidden from operators.

payment_sandbox_mode.label: Payment sandbox mode
payment_sandbox_mode.description: Route payments through the sandbox provider instead of production.
payment_sandbox_mode.tooltip: When enabled, payments use the sandbox provider. Provider Health shows the active route.

billing_from_email.label: Billing from email
billing_from_email.description: Sender address for billing email notifications.
billing_from_email.tooltip: Reserved for the email outbox worker. Stored and audited today.

email_template_payment_success.label: Payment success template
email_template_payment_success.description: Template code for successful payment emails.
email_template_payment_success.tooltip: References billing_email_templates. Email dispatch is a later phase.

email_template_payment_failed.label: Payment failed template
email_template_payment_failed.description: Template code for failed payment emails.
email_template_payment_failed.tooltip: References billing_email_templates. Email dispatch is a later phase.

email_template_expiring_soon.label: Expiring soon template
email_template_expiring_soon.description: Template code for renewal reminder emails.
email_template_expiring_soon.tooltip: References billing_email_templates. Reminder jobs are a later phase.

email_template_grace_period.label: Grace period template
email_template_grace_period.description: Template code for grace period notice emails.
email_template_grace_period.tooltip: References billing_email_templates. Sent when grace period starts in a later phase.

webhook_retry_max_attempts.label: Webhook retry max attempts
webhook_retry_max_attempts.description: Maximum delivery retries for outbound webhooks.
webhook_retry_max_attempts.tooltip: Reserved for webhook delivery worker. Stored and audited today.

webhook_retry_backoff_seconds.label: Webhook retry backoff
webhook_retry_backoff_seconds.description: Base backoff seconds between webhook retries.
webhook_retry_backoff_seconds.tooltip: Reserved for webhook delivery worker. Stored and audited today.

webhook_signature_tolerance_seconds.label: Webhook signature tolerance
webhook_signature_tolerance_seconds.description: Allowed clock skew for webhook signature validation.
webhook_signature_tolerance_seconds.tooltip: Reserved for inbound webhook verification. Stored and audited today.

usage_rollup_schedule_cron.label: Usage rollup schedule
usage_rollup_schedule_cron.description: Cron expression for usage aggregation jobs.
usage_rollup_schedule_cron.tooltip: Reserved for usage rollup worker. Stored and audited today.

usage_record_retention_days.label: Usage record retention
usage_record_retention_days.description: Days to retain granular usage records.
usage_record_retention_days.tooltip: Reserved for usage retention job. Stored and audited today.

health_probe_interval_seconds.label: Health probe interval
health_probe_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between billing provider health probes.
health_probe_interval_seconds.tooltip: Reserved for provider probe worker. Provider Health page reads snapshots today.

health_alert_threshold_failed_payments.label: Failed payment alert threshold
health_alert_threshold_failed_payments.description: Failed payments in 24h before degraded health status.
health_alert_threshold_failed_payments.tooltip: Reserved for health evaluator. Stored and audited today.

entitlements_cache_ttl_seconds.label: Entitlements cache TTL
entitlements_cache_ttl_seconds.description: Client-side entitlements cache time-to-live in seconds.
entitlements_cache_ttl_seconds.tooltip: Reserved for client cache wiring. Stored and audited today.
